coverage_contract_codes.agent-lifecycle-chat-state: Agent lifecycle, chat transport, durable state, and command safety.
coverage_contract_codes.archive-integrity-bounded-io: Archive integrity, bounded child/remote I/O, and receipt durability.
coverage_contract_codes.crash-recovery: Crash boundary, replay, recovery, and idempotence behavior.
coverage_contract_codes.dag-scheduler-enforcement: DAG parsing, scheduling, resource enforcement, attribution, and CLI behavior.
coverage_contract_codes.experiment-scheduling: Experiment planning, calibration, limits, and reporting.
coverage_contract_codes.fail-closed-safety: Malformed, changed, missing, or untrusted evidence must refuse safely.
coverage_contract_codes.git-data-preservation: Git/worktree/submodule/handoff state must not be lost during lifecycle mutation.
coverage_contract_codes.landing-plan-contract: Landing graph, prioritization, collection, and CLI behavior.
coverage_contract_codes.lifecycle-state-machine: Wrkslots state transitions and durable lifecycle invariants.
coverage_contract_codes.process-liveness: Real process identity, namespace, descriptor, socket, cgroup, and lsof evidence.
coverage_contract_codes.repository-infrastructure: Repository launchers, package/build wiring, selectors, and hermeticity.
coverage_contract_codes.remote-execution-session: Remote runner configuration, allowlisting, session state, and readiness.
coverage_contract_codes.tick-scheduling-state: Tick cadence, probe, persistence, and CLI behavior.
coverage_contract_codes.timeline-data-contract: Timeline ingestion, normalization, query, storage, rendering, and browser behavior.
coverage_contract_codes.wrkslots-accounting: Wrkslots census, budget, reservation, and cache-accounting behavior.

recommendation_codes.keep-focused-proc: Keep the real race but enumerate only its owned fixture PID; implemented and measured.
recommendation_codes.keep-harness-isolated: Keep behavior while suppressing unrelated ambient tmux-agent delay; implemented and measured.
recommendation_codes.fix-test-path-preflight: Keep test; ensure the validation environment exposes required toolchain binaries before collection.
recommendation_codes.stabilize-readiness: Keep process-tree behavior; replace brittle fixed readiness assumptions with event evidence or load-aware bounds.
recommendation_codes.shorten-test-only-deadline: Keep timeout/kill/reap behavior with a short explicit test budget and assert the production constant separately.
recommendation_codes.reduce-bounded-iterations: Keep fairness/boundary observations but stop once the declared evidence is satisfied, retaining a finite failure cap.
recommendation_codes.keep-isolated: High-value real integration behavior; retain as an isolated DAG node and profile internal phases.
recommendation_codes.keep-namespace-sharded: Retain destructive lifecycle coverage; shard by parameter family in independent user/PID namespaces.
recommendation_codes.keep-host-sharded: Retain host-identity behavior; shard only after repeated contamination and cleanup checks.
recommendation_codes.keep-profile-optimize: Retain the scenario, profile its setup/waits, and optimize without deleting the invariant.
recommendation_codes.keep-targeted: Cost is modest; run only for the owning component and its reverse dependencies.
